scope: A single coherent AxisCompact witness with both null momenta strictly positive
construction: Dichotomy: use the direct-positive label if its opposite momentum is already positive; otherwise use its symmetric sum with oppositeLift. In the zero case, the oppositeLift direct density and waves vanish almost everywhere, so the original positive direct density is preserved.
interpretation: One concrete coherent AxisCompact label has strictly positive P+ and P-. Together with the two previously proved boost-orbit integrability theorems, all fields needed to instantiate FutureNullState are available. Experimental confirmation is not claimed.
